prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Denver for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone in Denver — the right provider depends on what you need (age, complexity of your case), priorities (price, location, tech, experience with Invisalign), and your insurance. I can, however, help you find the best fit. Quick guidance plus next steps:

What to look for
- Board certification and membership in the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO). Board certification indicates extra testing/peer review.
- Experience with the specific treatment you want (braces vs Invisalign). Ask how many Invisalign cases they’ve treated and whether they’re a Platinum/Elite provider.
- Before-and-after photos of cases like yours.
- Technology and comfort: digital scans (iTero), CBCT if needed, accelerated options if you want faster treatment.
- Reviews and patient experience (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades) and office responsiveness.
- Cost, insurance acceptance, and financing options.
- Location, office hours, emergency care availability, and whether they treat adults vs kids/teens.

Questions to ask at a consult
- Am I a good candidate for Invisalign or do I need braces?
- How many similar cases have you completed?
- What’s the estimated treatment time and total cost (including retainers)?
- Do you use digital scanning? Will I see before/after simulations?
- What happens if attachments break or aligners are lost?
- Are you board-certified?

How to find candidates
- Use AAO’s “Find an Orthodontist” tool and the Invisalign Provider Locator.
- Search local reviews (Google/Yelp) and Instagram for before/after photos.
- Pick 3–4 offices for free or low-cost consults to compare plans.

Red flags
- Pressure to sign up immediately or pushy sales tactics.
- No willingness to show past work or explain alternatives.
- Vague answers about experience with Invisalign or clear aligner relapse rates.

If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in Denver
- Whether it’s for a child or adult and whether you prefer Invisalign or braces
- Any insurance you have

I can then put together a short list of well-reviewed, experienced orthodontists in your area and what to expect from each. Which would you like?
